name: graph-wiki
description: Build and maintain a persistent, cross-referenced markdown wiki alongside any source-code project — single packages, monorepos, or hybrid shapes. Builds a code graph and renders one page per entity (repository, domain, package, app, agent_plugin, dependency, test_suite) into a single entities/ folder, then keeps it current as the code evolves. This is the Claude Code host path; gw from graph-wiki-cli is the parallel Bedrock CLI companion over the same wiki-io surface.
